import os import sqlite3 from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template_string app = Flask(__name__) app.secret_key = os.environ.get("APP_SECRET", "default-secret-key") DB_PATH = "db.sqlite3" HTML_BASE = """ Recipe Sharing App
